record: Rule-6 mutants for the budget report and pre-spec verifier repair (syzygy-3rhe; review RD-6 B3, with A-3 and F-3 rows 3 and 5). Not authority.
method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` in one file of a fresh `git archive <commit> .syzygy` extraction (every occurrence, except I3 which inserts one clause before the first level-2 heading), then runs `command` from that extraction's root. A mutant is killed only when it replaced at least one occurrence, the command exits nonzero, and its output contains `expected`. Generator mutants (M*) break the repaired code; input mutants (I*) hand-edit the report or the rev9 corpus.

runner:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-3rhe: each is applied to a fresh `git archive`
extraction of .syzygy/ at the given commit; the named command must fail with
the expected text."""
import json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

REPO = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
COMMIT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
C = ".syzygy/governance/contracts/candidates"
BUD = f"{C}/scripts/build_budget_report.py"
VER = f"{C}/scripts/verify_final_prespec.py"
REPORT = f"{C}/CONTEXT-BUDGET-REPORT.md"
REV9 = f"{C}/history/rev9-rfcs/RFC-0009-orrery-map-surface.md"

MUTANTS = [
    # (id, kind, file, old, new, script, flag, expected)
    ("M1", "generator", BUD,
     '    a("**No as-of line.** The report names no commit and no working-tree")',
     '    a("**As-of commit:** `0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`")\n    a("**No as-of line.** The report names no commit and no working-tree")',
     BUD, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the generated report carries no machine-local commit"),
    ("M2", "generator", BUD,
     'CEILING_LABEL = "~7,000"', 'CEILING_LABEL = "7,000"',
     BUD, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the report states the module ceiling as approximate"),
    ("M3", "generator", VER,
     'fail(f"{rel}: {words} words exceeds the ~7,000-word module ceiling")',
     'fail(f"{rel}: {words} words exceeds the 7,000-word module ceiling")',
     VER, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: oversize module fails, naming the ~7,000-word ceiling"),
    ("M4", "generator", VER,
     "    elif derived != REV9_ENDS:", "    elif False:",
     VER, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: rev9 corpus maxima disagreeing with REV9_ENDS detected"),
    ("M5", "generator", VER,
     "    if not derived:", "    if False:",
     VER, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: missing rev9 corpus detected"),
    ("M6", "generator", VER,
     "REV9_ENDS = {1: 32, 2: 25, 3: 32, 4: 29, 5: 26, 6: 28, 7: 38, 8: 32, 9: 52}",
     "REV9_ENDS = {1: 32, 2: 25, 3: 32, 4: 29, 5: 26, 6: 28, 7: 38, 8: 32, 9: 51}",
     VER, "", "REV9_ENDS disagrees with the line-start clause maxima"),
    ("I1", "input", REPORT,
     "**No as-of line.**",
     "**As-of commit:** `0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`\n\n**No as-of line.**",
     BUD, "--check", "DRIFT: CONTEXT-BUDGET-REPORT.md — differs from regeneration"),
    ("I2", "input", REPORT,
     "| Module | Words | Over the ~7,000 ceiling |",
     "| Module | Words | Over the 7,000 ceiling |",
     BUD, "--check", "DRIFT: CONTEXT-BUDGET-REPORT.md — differs from regeneration"),
    ("I3", "input", REV9,
     "\n## ", "\n**RFC9-53.** An appended rev9 clause.\n\n## ",
     VER, "", "REV9_ENDS disagrees with the line-start clause maxima"),
]

results = []
for mid, kind, rel, old, new, script, flag, expect in MUTANTS:
    tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"3rhe-{mid}-"))
    try:
        archive = subprocess.run(["git", "archive", COMMIT, ".syzygy"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(tmp)], input=archive, check=True)
        target = tmp / rel
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        occurrences = text.count(old)
        if mid == "I3":
            target.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        cmd = [sys.executable, str(tmp / script)] + ([flag] if flag else [])
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = run.stdout + run.stderr
        killed = occurrences >= 1 and run.returncode != 0 and expect in out
        results.append({"id": mid, "kind": kind, "file": rel, "old": old, "new": new,
                        "occurrencesReplaced": 1 if mid == "I3" else occurrences,
                        "command": f"python3 {script} {flag}".strip(),
                        "expected": expect, "exitCode": run.returncode, "killed": killed,
                        "outputMatch": next((l for l in out.splitlines() if expect in l), None)})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

print(json.dumps({"commit": COMMIT, "mutants": results,
                  "killed": sum(r["killed"] for r in results), "total": len(results)}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
